coverage_notes: This dataset was compiled using only the WebSearch tool (WebFetch and direct HTTP access to Wikipedia/UEFA/ESPN/etc. were blocked by network egress policy in this environment). As a result: (1) European knockout-stage coverage is fairly complete for Champions League/UEFA Cup/Europa League ties from 2003-04 through 2025-26, with 2020-21 Champions League group-stage/knockout results and a handful of early-2000s group matches left incomplete or unconfirmed and therefore omitted; (2) all located major finals (Coupe de la Ligue 2001, Coupe de France 2008 and 2012, Coupe de la Ligue 2007 runners-up, six Trophée des Champions finals) are included; (3) A SECOND research pass (this one) added Ligue 1 league-match coverage using targeted WebSearch queries of the form '<Lyon> <Opponent> Ligue 1 <season> score result both matches ESPN', which reliably surfaced individual ESPN/SportsMole/FoxSports match pages with exact dates, scores and (often) goalscorers for both the home and away fixture against each opponent. Using this technique, Ligue 1 coverage is now effectively COMPLETE for 2022-23 (38/38 matches, 20-team season) and 2023-24 (34/34 matches, 18-team season), essentially complete for 2024-25 (34/34 matches), and substantially covered for 2025-26 (33 of 34 matches through matchday ~34 as of the compilation date; only the Lyon–Paris FC away leg could not be located). Earlier seasons (pre-2022) still have NO Ligue 1 league-match coverage in this file and would need the same per-opponent search technique applied season by season. (4) Home/away assignment for some ESPN-derived matches required cross-checking venue/attendance mentions against the literal 'TeamA N-M TeamB' title text, since ESPN's title and URL-slug ordering was found to be inconsistent (sometimes home team first, sometimes away team first, sometimes matching neither the venue actually reported in the same snippet); where a snippet explicitly named the stadium or attendance figure, that was used to determine home/away, overriding raw title order. A few individual scorer minutes/details (marked in the affected match's 'notes' field where relevant) reflect this reconciliation and carry slightly lower confidence than the scoreline/date/opponent/home-away fields, which were corroborated across multiple independent snippets in nearly all cases. (5) The task brief mentioned a '2024 Europa League final vs Olympiacos' as an example iconic match — this was checked and found to be inaccurate: Lyon did not play in continental competition in 2023-24 at all (finished 6th in Ligue 1, no European football that season); the 2024 match referenced was actually the UEFA Europa Conference League final (Olympiacos beat Fiorentina), which did not involve Lyon. It has been excluded to avoid publishing a fabricated match. (6) Several dates (marked 'approximate' in notes fields) are best-available estimates for matches where search results confirmed the score/round/opponent but not the exact calendar day; all scorelines and named goalscorers are drawn directly from verified search results and were not invented.
